name: Spaceship b36f22f2 on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003
description: A period-18 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-003 (touching neighbours), 10 to 14 cells, moving one lattice step every 18 generations (c/18). It runs the same way in the 32 rules from B4567/S3478 to B4,5,6,7,9,10/S0,3,4,7,8,9,10; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k2-004, k3-010 and k3-016. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-010 (seen 45 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
